body.title: Valorant Team to Win an International in 2026
body.description:
This market will resolve "Yes" if the listed team is crowned champion (wins the Grand Final) of at least one qualifying international VALORANT event concluding in the 2026 calendar year. Otherwise, this market will resolve "No."

For the purposes of this market, "qualifying international VALORANT event" means any of the following, and only the following:
Valorant Masters Santiago 2026 (February 28 – March 15, 2026)
Valorant Masters London 2026 (June 6 – June 21, 2026)
Esports World Cup 2026 — VALORANT (July 2 – July 12, 2026)
Valorant Champions 2026, Shanghai (September 24 – October 18, 2026)

In the case of a tie, the market will resolve to "Yes" for the team whose name appears first alphabetically.

This market resolves "Yes" as soon as the team wins any one qualifying event; winning more than one is not required. If the team wins none of the listed events, this market resolves "No."

If all qualifying events are cancelled, or are postponed such that no champion is determined for any of them by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the Riot Games VALORANT Esports website (https://valorantesports.com) and, for the Esports World Cup, the official EWC website (https://esportsworldcup.com/en/competitions/2026/valorant). A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
